name: AlgoGemix
summary: A NinjaTrader 8 suite for strategy automation, position sizing and hands-on trade management.
problem: A trader needs to size a position, inspect a signal and intervene in an automated strategy while the market keeps moving.
role: I developed the trading tools and designed the commercial licensing and affiliate workflows.
solution: GridPro handles strategy automation. AdvancedRiskReward brings position sizing and risk management into the trading workflow. PairZScore adds a statistical view of a pair’s relative movement.
architecture: NinjaScript components run inside NinjaTrader 8. The suite includes VolumeSpike, WaveTrend, ADXReversal, TiltPro, DowTheory and Savitzky–Golay filtering. JSON signal exports give external dashboards a data boundary separate from strategy execution.
ai: This project demonstrates statistical programming and operator-controlled automation. The documented trading features use rules and indicators. A model-driven execution component has not been established.
challenge: Keep human override accessible during automated operation, and separate exportable signals from proprietary trading logic.
progress: The suite has a public product site. The Stripe and Supabase affiliate platform is presented as design work.

name: Paranormal Atlas
summary: A geographic case archive that brings witness accounts, source material and competing explanations into one view.
problem: Accounts of one event can be scattered across interviews, historical records and videos, with conflicting descriptions repeated as fact.
role: I designed the research workflow, case structure and map-led reading experience.
solution: A map opens into a case file with evidence, witness accounts, a timeline and competing explanations. Roughly 850 case concepts form the research backlog.
architecture: The workflow moves from agent discovery to source validation, then into structured case records. Mapbox places those records geographically. The YouTube API provides a route to related media. Publishing automation and an illustrated encyclopedia extend the same case structure.
ai: Agents assist with discovery, extraction and draft assembly. Source review determines which claims belong in a case and how uncertainty is expressed.
challenge: Separate multiple reports of one event from independent corroboration, and keep opposing accounts legible on a phone.
progress: The development record includes database and API work, a mobile map shell, a Gemini video adapter and automation job definitions. The roughly 850 research leads await varying levels of review.

name: Utopic Dystopia
summary: A dark-fantasy RPG where cards discovered in the world become the pieces of a tactical 3D battle.
problem: Exploration and card combat need to feel like two parts of the same campaign. A card found in the environment needs a clear use on the board.
role: I direct game design, campaign structure, card design and the Godot prototype, working with AI coding agents.
solution: A Gwent-inspired 3D battle prototype anchors the game. More than 100 cards have been designed. Campaign plans connect character selection, exploration and card discovery to encounters.
architecture: JSON-driven card and campaign data provide a shared vocabulary for combat and progression. Godot scenes represent the board and world. Development is organized through GitHub.
ai: Coding agents assist with prototype iteration. Concept art explores how a location should feel before it becomes a playable environment.
challenge: Make card abilities readable on a 3D board while keeping the board visually grounded in the world.
progress: 3D battle prototype. Baz Abbot is the initial leader. Pre-level character selection and world discovery belong to the wider campaign design.

name: DK Foods Wholesale
summary: A wholesale operations suite designed to surface time-sensitive orders, invoices and procurement opportunities.
problem: An important order can look like an ordinary email. Staff need an alert while their inbox still shows which messages they have personally opened.
role: I mapped the distributor’s operations and designed the agent deployment, classification and notification workflows.
solution: The design monitors incoming mail, flags orders and invoices, and routes important notifications to WhatsApp. Separate research tasks cover government procurement, restaurant leads and recurring reports.
architecture: Hermes Agent configuration connects inbox monitoring, model-based classification and a notification destination. The design preserves unread state. Legacy order entry is a later integration with a human review point.
ai: Multi-model orchestration assigns routine screening and higher-judgment research different inference budgets.
challenge: Keep alerts actionable while protecting customer information and controlling recurring inference costs.
progress: Deployment and integration work is in progress. Production delivery, throughput and savings have not been verified.

name: Nation’s Ghost & Baileys Ghost
summary: Original records, cinematic music videos and short-form campaigns built around two artist projects.
problem: A single song needs a coherent visual identity across a full-length video, cover artwork and many short edits.
role: I write and produce as Baileys Ghost and collaborate with DatBoiBaz as Nation’s Ghost. My work spans creative direction, editing, mixing and mastering.
solution: Each release starts with the music. Shot concepts, generated sequences and cover art develop its visual language before editorial cuts are made for different channels.
architecture: Audio production and mastering feed the video edit. A reusable inventory of clips supports distribution and scheduling across both artist identities.
ai: Generative video and image tools support shot development, artwork and visual continuity. Editing and audio decisions stay tied to the song.
challenge: Maintain recognizable characters and a consistent mood across separately generated shots, then find a short edit that still carries the song.
progress: Released music and ongoing production. My production inventory includes approximately ten full-length videos and hundreds of promotional assets.
